name: 小青
style_lock: 空心圆头，没有头发和耳朵
脖子上系一条青色围巾

prompt_lock.zh: 原创手绘火柴人知识节目主持人：黑色墨线，线条有轻微粗细变化和手抖感；空心圆头，没有头发和耳朵，椭圆形黑眼睛，简笔的眉和嘴；四肢是单根细线，手脚是小椭圆；脖子上系一条青色围巾，两条短飘带垂在身后；约 4 头身，全身入镜。
prompt_lock.en: Original hand-drawn stick-figure explainer host: black ink lines with slight pressure variation and a hand-drawn wobble; a hollow circle head with no hair or ears, black oval eyes, simple line brows and mouth; single thin lines for limbs, small ovals for hands and feet; a teal scarf around the neck with two short tails hanging behind; about 4 heads tall, full body in frame.
